issues.title: Define-XML copy source ADSL.TRTDUR does not exist in ADSL
issues.summary: Define-XML documents ADTTE.TRTDUR as a copy of ADSL.TRTDUR, but the published ADSL has no TRTDUR; the specification reads ADSL.TRTDURD instead.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.TRTDUR names ADSL.TRTDUR as its copy source.
issues.observed: ADSL has no variable TRTDUR (Define-XML ADSL lists TRTDURD). adtte_v2.yaml line 30 derives TRTDUR from ADSL.TRTDURD.
issues.action: Correct the Define-XML source of ADTTE.TRTDUR to ADSL.TRTDURD, or add ADSL.TRTDUR if that was intended, so the documented copy source exists.

issues.title: STARTDT reads ADSL.TRTSDT, not the documented ADSL.RFSTDTC
issues.summary: Define-XML names ADSL.RFSTDTC as the source of ADTTE.STARTDT; the specification copies ADSL.TRTSDT. The two give the same values on this submission.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.STARTDT is a copy of ADSL.RFSTDTC, the reference start date that ADSL takes from DM.RFSTDTC.
issues.observed: adtte_v1.yaml line 166 derives STARTDT from ADSL.TRTSDT, the first treatment date. The documented source differs from the reference on 0 of 254 records.
issues.action: Decide whether STARTDT is the reference start date or the first treatment date, then align the Define-XML source and the specification.

issues.title: ADT event date accepts events on TRTSDT where Define-XML says after TRTSDT
issues.summary: Define-XML takes ADAE.ASTDT only when it occurred after TRTSDT; the reference, the specification and the Pilot 3 program adtte.r accept a first dermatologic event dated on TRTSDT.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.ADT: if ADAE.ASTDT is not missing and occurred after TRTSDT then ADAE.ASTDT, else convert ADSL.RFENDTC to a SAS numeric date.
issues.observed: The literal rule differs from the reference on 5 of 254 records; the on-or-after reading and the adtte.r reading reproduce it. adtte_v1.yaml and adtte.r lines 48-58 apply no after-TRTSDT test.
issues.action: Decide whether the event must fall strictly after or on or after TRTSDT, then correct the Define-XML ADT method or the derivation, and state the date test in the specification.

issues.action: Confirm that AOCC01FL alone identifies the dermatologic event (its Define-XML method is questioned under SRCSEQ), or add the CQ01NAM condition to FIRST_DERM.

issues.title: adtte.r censors at the disposition date, not the documented ADSL.RFENDTC
issues.summary: Define-XML sets ADT for a subject without an event from ADSL.RFENDTC; the Pilot 3 program adtte.r uses the DS disposition date, or RFENDTC only for a subject who died.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADTTE.ADT: else convert ADSL.RFENDTC to a SAS numeric date.
issues.observed: adtte.r lines 72-94 set the censor date EOS2DT to RFENDTC when DCDECOD is DEATH and to the DS disposition date otherwise; its comment says this was observed through QC but not described in specs.
issues.action: Decide which censor date the analysis intends, and either document the disposition and death-date rule in Define-XML ADTTE.ADT or confirm RFENDTC as the censor date.

issues.action: Correct the Define-XML ADAE.AOCC01FL method to the dermatologic CQ01NAM value, and decide whether FIRST_DERM should also state the CQ01NAM condition.
